link.title: Link sensors
link.intro: For each sensor of the senseBox, choose the Homey device that provides the reading. Leave a sensor empty to skip it.
link.outdoor_hint: Only link outdoor sensors: indoor readings give the wrong picture on the map.
link.indoor_box: This senseBox is set to "indoor" on openSenseMap.
link.no_sensors: This senseBox has no sensors yet. Add them on opensensemap.org and reload the sensor list.
link.no_options: No Homey devices with numeric readings were found.
link.unit_warning: Units differ: Homey measures in __homey__, openSenseMap expects __osem__.
link.unit_unknown: Homey has no unit for this reading; check that it matches __osem__.
link.no_boxes_left: All senseBoxes of this account have already been added.
link.need_login: Sign in to openSenseMap again to continue.
